growth_provenance: Provisional planning convention (research Report 05 s3): 2036 re-anchors the legacy 2035 cases; 2046 inherits the legacy 2050 cases on the evidence that regional adoption is front-loaded; 2056 extends with saturation capped by pathway capacity. Status: synthetic_uncalibrated - pending team adoption and observed-data calibration.

demand_model.provenance: Coefficients are synthetic screening values chosen by the team for the V2 prototype; no published derivation exists. They must not be presented as calibrated. Calibration path: fcf_m2.demand.calibrate() with observed session data.

base_load_growth_per_year.label: commercial base-load growth planning proxy (assumption; facility interval data pending)

energy_per_session_kwh.label: benchmark assumption (typical public L2 session), TBV with observed data

economics.provenance: All cost lines are screening/planning benchmarks (AFDC/NREL cost classes + client operating evidence). None are quotes, budgets, or engineering estimates. Site quotes, the Dominion tariff, and vendor fee schedules are required before any budget use.

emissions.grid_factor_source: EPA eGRID2023 Rev 2 (data year 2023, released 2025-06-12), SRVC subregion, total output emission rate CO2e
emissions.grid_factor_next_refresh: eGRID2024 (preliminary API data available 2026; re-pull official release annually)
emissions.assumption_note: energy/session 9.5 kWh (benchmark); EV efficiency 0.3 kWh/mi (EPA-class benchmark); displaced gasoline LDV 400.0 gCO2/mi (fleet-average-class benchmark); charger efficiency 0.92. No observed baseline exists yet - values are screening estimates, not measured reductions.

equity_override.note: Equity override allows expansion review at lower observed utilization in high-equity-need areas; requires the same human approval gate.

capacity: service/spare capacity NULL with capacity_basis=placeholder at all 12 sites until utility/facility confirmation

contract_v3.derivation: a new run of model version 3.1.0 on the reference study's inputs, put into contract v2's container; not derived from v1 or v2.
contract_v3.plan: the milestone2_v3 port plan follows the fixed-anchor ranking; the pathway is the V3 rule over the V3 2036/2046 targets (DEC-027).
contract_v3.observed_data: 0 capacity observation set(s) and 0 session summary/summaries applied. Zero means no field data has been received; every observed_* field is empty and every row reports awaiting_observed_data.
contract_v3.empty_means: An empty observed_* field means NOT OBSERVED. It never means zero.
